legal.title: Terms and Privacy
legal.terms_intro: By using Jess BOT, you agree to the following terms and conditions of use.

terms_content.acceptance_desc: By adding Jess BOT to your Discord server or using our services, you agree to be bound by these terms.
terms_content.service_desc: Jess BOT is a Discord bot that provides file conversion services, including video to GIF conversion, image optimization, and banner creation.
terms_content.usage_desc: You may use Jess BOT to convert personal files respecting size limits (up to 50MB) and supported formats.
terms_content.prohibited_desc: It is prohibited to use the bot to process illegal, harmful, offensive content or content that violates third-party copyrights.
terms_content.limitations_desc: Jess BOT is provided 'as is'. We do not guarantee 100% service availability and are not responsible for data loss.
terms_content.changes_desc: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Significant changes will be communicated to users.

legal.privacy_intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect and use your information.

privacy_content.collection_desc: We collect only information necessary for bot operation: user ID, files sent for conversion, and usage settings.
privacy_content.usage_desc: Your information is used exclusively to process file conversions and improve our services.
privacy_content.storage_desc: Uploaded files are processed temporarily and automatically deleted after 24 hours. We do not store content permanently.
privacy_content.sharing_desc: We do not share, sell, or distribute your personal information with third parties, except when required by law.
privacy_content.security_desc: We implement adequate security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access.
privacy_content.rights_desc: You can request deletion of your information or stop using the bot at any time by removing it from your server.
privacy_content.contact_desc: For questions about this policy, contact us through our official Discord server.
